info.name: Exposed Prototype
info.description: Exposed prototypes are failed experimental robots that were exposed to the Catarsys in a high level of contamination. They now exhale a toxic gas that can affect the heroes and make them weaker.
info.lore: Exposed prototypes are the result of failed experiments in the creation of advanced robotic beings. They were exposed to the Catarsys in a high level of contamination and became toxic for anyone who comes into contact with them.

characteristics.body: Rusty robots that act mindlessly, attacking anything that moves. They are made of metal and have a humanoid shape, but their design is crude and unfinished.

outfit.description: Discarded prototypes have no outfit, as they are unfinished robots. Their metal bodies are exposed and show signs of wear and tear.

hidden.realLore: Just like the exposed prototypes, they are dead people that were exposed to the Catarsys in a high level. The contamination made them lose their minds instantly and became toxic.
